title: Uncertainty within a changing shared course
meaning: Adaptable action arising from uncertain impressions is emotionally experienced as changing circumstances that resist a final explanation.
text: In this Energy Field, the Wheel of Fortune in the physical position concerns changing shared actions, while in emotions it describes experiencing the alternation of circumstances. The Moon in energy indicates motivation arising among unclear impressions, conjectures and imagined possibilities. You may adjust your practical course while trying to understand a situation that has not yet taken shape, and simultaneously feel the familiar picture shifting again. The Wheel’s two roles do not mean doubled luck or a necessarily favourable outcome.

For example, the weather forecast changes several times before your trip. You move the walk, pack different clothes and discuss possible routes, although there is still no definite picture. Each update brings another response, from relief to frustration. **We are already changing our actions, although we do not yet know what the situation will be.** The changeability of your shared day is experienced separately from the accuracy of your predictions.

A difficulty appears if every conjecture immediately produces another adjustment. Actions then follow anxious images faster than information arrives. Alternatively, a strong feeling of change may seem to confirm a particular forecast. The Moon does not turn impressions into facts. The Wheel in emotions describes experiencing changeability, rather than knowing the next turn. An uncertain motive can remain present even when the resulting alteration of plans is entirely real and noticeable to both people.
